_readme: OPTIONAL. Copy this file into the repo as  api/ui-settings.json  to take
control of the launcher's Settings page from the API side — no new .exe.
The launcher reads it from the downloaded api folder every time it starts
and after every update. Rules it applies afterwards:
* a field whose 'key' is not read by the API source is hidden,
* 'default' and the value type are taken from the API source, not here,
* anything you do not list still shows up on the Advanced page.
If this file is malformed the launcher says so in the log and keeps its
own built-in layout — it never silently ignores you.
kind: str | int | float | bool | choice | secret
